categories.main_business_segments: Haesung DS Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the semiconductor materials industry, focusing on manufacturing and selling semiconductor substrates used in packaging processes. The main product lines include leadframes (about 64% of sales) and package substrates (about 36% of sales). The company also pursues future business opportunities in graphene production and applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes stamping (SLF) and etching (ELF) methods for leadframe production and advanced multilayer circuit technologies for package substrates. It has proprietary Palladium Pre-Plated Frame (PPF) plating technology, which is environmentally friendly and was first developed globally in 1998. For graphene, it employs chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and flake exfoliation methods to produce high-quality graphene materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include integrated device manufacturers (IDMs) such as Infineon, ST Micro, NXP, and assembly outsourcing companies (OSATs) like ASE, Amkor, SPIL, JCET, and UTAC for leadframes. Package substrates are mainly supplied to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The end markets served include automotive semiconductors, mobile devices, PCs, servers, and memory semiconductors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Haesung DS operates globally with significant export sales accounting for approximately 99% of revenue. It has sales offices and subsidiaries in China, Japan (Fukuoka), the United States, and the Philippines. Its major production customers have manufacturing bases primarily in China and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream semiconductor supply chain as a semiconductor back-end process supplier, producing structural packaging materials (semiconductor substrates) essential for chip packaging and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening technological competitiveness in leadframes and package substrates through continuous R&D on new processes, materials, and solutions. The company invests in developing high-value-added products, enhancing manufacturing competitiveness, and expanding into emerging materials like graphene. It also emphasizes ESG management and environmental compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor substrates, including leadframes and package substrates. Sales are mostly export-driven, with pricing linked to raw material market prices to mitigate cost volatility risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the leadframe market include Mitsui High-tec, CWTC, Shinko Electric, Adv. Assembly Material, SDI, and Jin Lin. Haesung DS holds a leading global position with a growing market share, especially in the high-reliability automotive semiconductor segment. In package substrates, competitors include Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Ibiden, Shinko, and Daeduck Electronics, with Haesung DS competing based on technology and cost competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately KRW 672 billion and operating profit of KRW 102.5 billion. Despite a 19.9% sales decline due to semiconductor market downturns, it maintained strong profitability with an operating margin of 15.2%. Total assets stood at KRW 688.7 billion with equity of KRW 515 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haesung DS differentiates itself through high-quality, reliable semiconductor substrates with proprietary environmentally friendly plating technology (PPF). It focuses on high-reliability automotive semiconductor materials, leveraging long-term customer trust and advanced manufacturing capabilities. The company also pursues innovation in graphene materials to expand future business opportunities.
